thread:
harper: Quick sync request — we need to finalize the 'route-scoped SA' migration UX and telemetry. TL;DR: want console health card, deterministic billing rule, and low-friction canary.

jules: Can we avoid breaking existing project keys? customers hate forced changes.

leo: We can keep project keys but introduce ephemeral route-bound SAs on exchange. key idea: preserve original "origin_key" header for billing and attach "effective_sa" for enforcement.

harper: Two billing options: bill-by-origin (safe) or bill-by-effective (accurate for SA owners). Default = bill-by-origin for migration. billing-svc, any red flags?

billing-svc: bill-by-origin is easiest for invoices. But we must surface a reconciliation export when customers opt-in to bill-by-effective. We'll need mapping table: original_key -> effective_sa -> time window.

maya-ui: For console: propose a compact migration health card per org: status pill (Legacy / Mixed / SA-only), migration delta (tokens/day moved), #quota-denies change, and a canary slider (0-100%). Clicking expands to a table: sample rows with origin_key, effective_sa, route, tokens, last_seen.

jules: Nice. Also need a per-route impact view: some routes (embeddings) are heavy. show expected token delta when enabling canary.

leo: Implementation note: sampling must happen before token exchange at the LB so we record origin key. We'll emit an ExchangeEvent when we mint an SA and attach both ids to the trace. Short example header pattern:

X-Auth-Origin: key_proj_12345
X-Auth-Exchange: sa_tmp_abcdefgh

And a tiny SQL to power the card:

```sql
SELECT origin_key, effective_sa, route, sum(tokens) as tokens_moved, count(1) as reqs
FROM telemetry.requests_sampled
WHERE ts > now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY 1,2,3
ORDER BY tokens_moved DESC
LIMIT 100;
```

harper: Also need to solve "billing drift" when a single request crosses owners (proxying). Suggest canonicalization rule: if origin_key belongs to org A and effective_sa belongs to org B, bill to origin unless org A opts-into forward-billing. Record both on invoice line for clarity.

billing-svc: Agree. Add a reconciliation CSV that shows both billed_to and effective_owner columns.

ops-bot: NOTE: We're seeing a small uptick in quota-deny errors in staging for /v1/chat/completions after enabling sampling — +14% since 1788888800. sample_ids: ["s1","s2","s3"].

jules: That might be the sampling lookup latency amplifying some spike. Leo, can we WL the lookup and measure p95 impact?

leo: Will do. My plan: keep sampling syncronous but microcache origin_key -> org mapping for 5s to avoid DB hits on hot keys. Should be sub-ms on hit.

maya-ui: UX copy: under migration card include a one-liner: "Enable route-scoped service accounts to enforce finer quotas and least-privilege. Start with telemetry-only to preview billing impact." and a link to docs.

harper: Rollout plan proposal: Phase 0 telemetry-only (2 weeks), Phase 1 opt-in enforcement (org-level toggle + canary slider), Phase 2 soft-enforce (log + headers + audit), Phase 3 enforce (hard deny). Each phase gated by feature-flag and usage thresholds.

jules: Add a safety net: when enforcement would deny >0.5% of org traffic we auto-reduce canary to previous value and emit incident to the org owner.

leo: We'll also add a per-org alert rule: if quota-deny rate increases by X% vs baseline, post to #eng-oncall and create a ticket.

billing-svc: One more: Ensure exported billing lines include token counts attributed to both keys for the same time bucket so finance can re-run invoices if needed. CSV fields: ts_bucket, origin_key, origin_org, effective_sa, effective_org, tokens.

ops-bot: deploy: infra/token-exchange-sampling rolled to canary (3/50 hosts) 178888892020 success.

harper: Great. Action items:
- Leo: implement pre-exchange sampling + ExchangeEvent log + microcache (owner: eng-runtime)
- Maya: mockups and copy for migration health card + canary slider (owner: devex/console)
- Jules: write safety-net logic & alert thresholds (owner: eng-platform)
- Billing-svc: spec for reconciliation CSV and opt-in flag behavior (owner: finance-api)

leo: I'll post a link to the telemetry query and a draft dashboard when done.

jules: I'll run perf tests and post p95 / p99.

harper: Sync Thurs 10am to review telemetry signals and mockups. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
